title: [tenmin-mode] planUpgraded: characterization test for plan-upgrade detection
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for planUpgraded in src/tenmin-mode.ts: plan upgrades
- planUpgraded({ windowStart: "2024-01-01", ratePerMin: 5 }, undefined) is false
- planUpgraded({ windowStart: "2023-01-01", ratePerMin: 5 }, { windowStart: "2024-01-01", ratePerMin: 5 }) is true
- planUpgraded({ windowStart: "2024-01-01", ratePerMin: 10 }, { windowStart: "2024-01-01", ratePerMin: 5 }) is true
- planUpgraded({ windowStart: "2025-01-01", ratePerMin: 5 }, { windowStart: "2024-01-01", ratePerMin: 10 }) is false

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). Plan-upgrade detection (an older window or a higher rate than the previous plan) has no direct test; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 5c41528 (Workspace main efd3f76, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with planUpgraded stubbed); suite 564/564 with all eight new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
